content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project using a [product_name] and need to export data via the Ethernet port. Specifically, I want to read values from four analog inputs in real time through an assigned IP address, which will be accessed by a PC application developed for this purpose. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user aims to obtain real-time analog input data from a [product_name] via Ethernet by querying its assigned IP address from a custom PC application. Their main concern is having an easy method to retrieve and monitor analog data in a networked environment for integration with external software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward approach to accessing real-time analog input data from the [product_name] over Ethernet, using an IP address for seamless integration with their custom PC application.
